title: Pick a look for Hermann's routine page
question: Four looks for the page you'll send your buddy. Each preview shows the first screen. Pick one, steer it, or ask for a fresh hand.

options.label: Stage Race Road Book
options.lineage: stage-race road books and Tyvek race bibs
options.thesis: Your week as a six-stage race: each training day is a stage with its own bib number and start list.
options.viewport: Today's stage as a giant bib numeral beside its exercise start list; a strip of seven bibs below shows the whole week.
options.risk: The race metaphor can tip into costume if the bib appears on every element instead of once per day.

raised.raise: Every stage bib is set at one fixed scale on one shared baseline, so days compare at a glance.
Exercise order is numbered 01–08 in a strict margin column.
One active ultramarine band marks today; nothing else on the page is lit.
No boxes around exercise rows: rank comes from weight and size, never enclosure.
One condensed family carries the page; hierarchy is size steps only.

options.label: Printed Timetable
options.thesis: The week read like a train timetable: days are columns, exercises are stops, today's column is the train you're on.
options.viewport: A full timetable grid of Monday to Sunday with today's column struck in signal red and its detail opened beside it.
options.risk: Familiar: Swiss-grid timetables are where many runs land, and it reads more 'schedule' than 'workout'.

options.label: Cutting Bench Rail
options.lineage: film editing bench, perforated work print
options.thesis: The week as a strip of film: seven frames on a rail, a folded orange flag on today, exercises hanging below.
options.viewport: A perforated rail of seven day-frames across the top with today flagged, and today's exercises hung as white cards below.
options.case: Strong on clarity: seven frames and one flag read instantly. Weaker on identity: nothing about it says gym or trail.
options.risk: Can read as a film-editing app rather than a workout page.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Each day as a plate in a growth sequence.
options.viewport: Seven fixed-scale plates on one baseline.
options.case: Loses both axes: nothing in it speaks to lifting or riding.
options.risk: Pretty but unrelated to the subject.
options.kept: Fixed scale on one shared baseline, so days compare directly.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: The routine set as a pixel-type specimen.
options.viewport: Day names in giant pixel letters over dense columns.
options.case: Loses both axes: the type performs instead of the routine.
options.kept: One family, hierarchy by size steps alone.

options.label: Origami Sequence
options.thesis: The week as numbered fold steps.
options.viewport: Numbered steps down a strict margin column.
options.case: Loses both axes: the metaphor needs explaining.
options.kept: Steps numbered in a strict margin column.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: The week as a building section with sun moving through it.
options.viewport: A long section with today's room lit.
options.case: Loses both axes: elegant idea, wrong world.
options.risk: Abstract for a friend glancing on a phone.
options.kept: One moving band of light marks now; nothing else is lit.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: The routine as bitmap lines drifting over a black void.
options.viewport: One still line of today's workout over drifting dust.
options.case: Loses both axes: novelty over legibility.
options.risk: Hard to read at a glance.
options.kept: No enclosing boxes; rank comes from weight, not containers.

canonCard.label: The fitness-app standard
canonCard.thesis: What workout apps ship: dark screen, a card per day, one bright accent.
canonCard.viewport: A dark grid of day cards with today highlighted in lime and its exercises listed.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every fitness app by design.
